name: Brian Lovin
bio: Brian Lovin is a software designer in San Francisco currently making AI products at Notion. He co-founded Campsite, designed GitHub Mobile after Spectrum’s acquisition, and earlier designed payments at Facebook and was first product designer at Buffer. He co-hosted Design Details for years and created Staff Design, an interview project on IC career paths.
highlights: Designing AI products at Notion; prior Campsite, GitHub Mobile, Spectrum.
Created Staff Design and long-running Design Details podcast co-host.
